messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Surya Kaushik vysyaraju

surya kaushik vysyaraju... that's a name with some weight to it. sounds like someone who either runs things or should be running things.

where you working these days?
Google

google... building the backbone of the internet while probably complaining about promo cycles like everyone else there.

found surya kaushik vysyaraju - software engineer @ google. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/surya-kaushik-vysyaraju
The scale which they work at
Yeah it's mee

software engineer at google... building search algorithms that decide what the world sees, or stuck debugging someone else's legacy code? the gap between the google mystique and the daily grind is real.

what made you pick google over the startup chaos? stability play or genuinely excited about the tech?

makes sense. billion users vs thousand users hits different when you're an engineer. seeing your code impact half the planet is addictive.

how long you been working total?
3 years total 8 months in Google

3 years total, 8 months at google... so you did 2+ years somewhere else before making the jump to mountain view. classic move - get some experience, then go for the big leagues.

what kind of role you looking for next?
I am looking for senior backend developer roles with low latency platforms

senior backend with low latency... trading firms, gaming, fintech infra. places where milliseconds = millions. google's scale is cute but wait till you see hft systems where 1ms delay costs actual money.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes
Any thing works
3 years experience + senior backend developer + low latency platforms + flexible location... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

Yes
  Thank you

welcome to the tal family legend 🔥

you're now locked and loaded. when the right low latency backend role drops - trading firm paying 60L+, gaming company building the next big thing, or fintech startup that actually has their shit together - you'll be the first to know.

time to level up from google to something that'll make your bank account as happy as your terminal.

Thank you
